title: Location
description: Where a startup is based. Set at creation; it cannot change once a simulation has started.

country.description: Only India for now; the field lets other countries be added later.

state.description: ISO 3166-2:IN state or union territory code, e.g. KA.

city.description: City name: a listed city's name, or any other city the founder typed.

oneOf.description: Id of a listed city, e.g. bengaluru.

cityId.description: The listed city's id, or null for any other city (profile from state and tier).
